description.en: Electric field (E) oscillates along y-axis, Magnetic field (B) oscillates along z-axis, and the wave propagates along x-axis.
description.hi: विद्युत क्षेत्र (E) y-अक्ष के अनुदिश दोलन करता है, चुंबकीय क्षेत्र (B) z-अक्ष के अनुदिश दोलन करता है, और तरंग x-अक्ष के अनुदिश संचरित होती है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(50, 150)">
    <!-- Axes -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="400" y2="0" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="410" y="5" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#9ca3af">x (Propagation, c)</text>
    
    <line x1="0" y1="100" x2="0" y2="-120" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="-15" y="-125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#9ca3af">y</text>
    
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-40" y2="80" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="-50" y="95" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#9ca3af">z</text>

    <!-- Electric Field E (Red, in XY plane) -->
    <path d="M 0 0 Q 40 -100 80 0 T 160 0 T 240 0 T 320 0" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="40" y1="0" x2="40" y2="-50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="120" y1="0" x2="120" y2="50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="200" y1="0" x2="200" y2="-50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <text x="20" y="-60" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">E</text>

    <!-- Magnetic Field B (Blue, in XZ plane - drawn pseudo-3D) -->
    <path d="M 0 0 Q 40 50 80 0 T 160 0 T 240 0 T 320 0" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" />
    <!-- To give 3D feel for Z axis -->
    <line x1="20" y1="0" x2="10" y2="18" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="40" y1="0" x2="20" y2="25" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="60" y1="0" x2="30" y2="18" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
    
    <line x1="100" y1="0" x2="110" y2="-18" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="120" y1="0" x2="130" y2="-25" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="140" y1="0" x2="150" y2="-18" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
    
    <text x="40" y="45" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">B</text>
  </g>
</svg>
